question: Which of these is a number that is real but NOT rational?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ A real number that is not rational is called an irrational number. Square roots of non-perfect squares are always irrational. Since 7 is not a perfect square, its square root cannot be written as a simple fraction. The numbers 3/4, 5, and −2 are clearly rational as they can easily be expressed in the form p/q. **∴ The correct answer is √7.**
